title: Files
description: File manager (capability files). All file operations ride POST /files with envelope gating protocol_v->min_peer_build->capability->token->payload. Chunks are 1 MiB raw max (~1.4 MiB b64) to stay under MaxBodyBytes 8 MiB. Paths are sandboxed rel paths: no absolute, no .., no \, no NUL/control, max 1024, per-component printable UTF-8 (spaces, parentheses etc allowed) plus / separator. Total file size max 8 GiB. Listing request/response uses req_id correlation: file-list {path, req_id} -> ack pong, then peer sends file-list-resp {req_id, entries} back over same /files lane. Transfers are idempotent by transfer_id+offset, final chunk commits atomically. Upload conflict policy (additive, old peers ignore): file-chunk may carry policy overwrite|if_newer (default legacy keep-both suffix) plus source_mtime (unix seconds, sender mtime truncated) for if_newer comparison; skip/keep_both/stop are sender-side only and never sent. Receivers with the files-ack capability verify sha256 on commit and confirm via file-ack{transfer_id, ok, error}; either side may abort a transfer with file-cancel{transfer_id, path?} and the receiver discards staged bytes. Resumable senders ask file-stat-req{transfer_id} and the receiver answers file-stat-resp{transfer_id, next_chunk, total_chunks} (smallest missing chunk; unknown transfers answer error and the sender restarts from zero).

nonce.description: Random per-message value the ack must echo.

path.description: Sandboxed relative path: no leading /, no .., no \, no NUL/control, per-component printable UTF-8 plus / separator. Empty means root.

error.description: Optional error string for file-list-resp (e.g. not found, not a directory).

error_code.description: Machine error_code: permission_denied, not_found, invalid_arg, internal. Separate from human error.

permission.description: Which permission domain failed: files or photos. Lets Mac render separate empty-states.

transfer_id.description: Hex id for chunked transfer (16-64 hex chars, crypto/rand).

offset.description: Byte offset of this chunk in the file.

total_size.description: Total file size in bytes (all chunks must agree).

total_chunks.description: Total number of chunks for this transfer.

data_b64.description: Base64 chunk bytes (~1 MiB raw -> ~1.4 MiB b64). Empty allowed for zero-byte file.

sha256.description: Optional hex sha256 of the full file (sent on last chunk for verification).

policy.description: Upload conflict policy, sender-side intent: overwrite always replaces, if_newer replaces only when source is newer (source_mtime+total_size vs target). Empty means legacy keep-both (receiver suffixes a copy). skip/keep_both/stop never ride the wire.

source_mtime.description: Sender file mtime, unix seconds truncated to match file-list-resp mod_time. Used only with policy if_newer.

ok.description: file-ack only: true when the receiver committed the transfer, false on rejection (error carries the reason).

next_chunk.description: file-stat-resp only: smallest missing chunk index (== total_chunks when nothing is missing).

from.description: Source path for file-rename (sandboxed rel path).

to.description: Destination path for file-rename (sandboxed rel path, same directory rename only recommended).
